intro: This privacy notice explains how Essentia — The Salon Lounge handles information when you contact us. This website is a marketing site with no accounts, bookings or forms.

sections.title: What we collect
items: This website does not collect personal data through forms.
If you message us on WhatsApp, call or email, we receive only what you choose to share there.
Basic technical data such as browser type and pages visited if analytics is enabled later.

sections.title: How we use it
items: To respond to service and package enquiries you send by WhatsApp, phone or email.
To schedule visits and share salon information you requested.

sections.title: Sharing
items: We do not sell your personal information.
Messages you send via WhatsApp are processed under WhatsApp’s own terms.

sections.title: Contact
items: Email support@theessentiasalon.com or call +91 9644 38 38 38 to ask about or withdraw consent for data you shared with us.
